setting.help: Validation hits FBR's validateinvoicedata_sb endpoint (pre-submit check, no real tax record created). Production hits the real PostInvoiceData_v1 endpoint - only switch once you're actually ready to file real invoices. Whichever mode is active determines which token below gets used.
Sandbox/validation token issued by FBR/PRAL (IRIS > Digital Invoicing > API Integration). Used only while FBR Mode above is Validation.
Production token issued by FBR/PRAL - separate from the sandbox token above. Used only once FBR Mode is switched to Production.
Pulls UoM, HS codes, provinces, sale types, doc types and SRO items live from FBR. Save this page first so the token above is persisted.
